# Getting involved in the community {.unnumbered}

The community is diverse and anyone can contribute without necessarily taking on an official leadership role.

## Core team

placeholder

## Community Advisory Board (CAB)

More information on [this page](https://bioconductor.org/about/community-advisory-board/) of the Bioconductor website.

## Technical Advisory Board (TAB)

More information on [this page](https://bioconductor.org/about/technical-advisory-board/) of the Bioconductor website.

## Code of Conduct committee (CoC)

The Bioconductor website maintains a [Code of Conduct](https://bioconductor.org/about/code-of-conduct/) page that redirects to the multilingual [Project-wide Code of Conduct statement for Bioconductor](https://bioconductor.github.io/bioc_coc_multilingual/) which is progressively being transfered to the [Code of Conduct](../code_of_conduct.md) section of this handbook.

## Working groups

The Bioconductor working groups - current, proposed, and retired - are described on [this website](https://workinggroups.bioconductor.org/).
